title: Payments
description: Money received from customers. Payments are never deleted; a mistake is voided with a reason.

form.title: Record a payment
form.orderHint: Optional. Leave it on account to reduce the overall balance.
form.noOpenOrders: This customer has no unpaid orders; the payment goes on account.
form.referenceHint: Optional, e.g. a receipt, transfer or cheque number.

validation.amount: Enter an amount above zero (up to 2 decimals).
validation.exceeds: This is more than the {{amount}} outstanding on the order.
validation.date: Choose a date that isn't in the future.

void.title: Void this payment?
void.body: The payment of {{amount}} from {{name}} stays on record but no longer counts toward the balance. This can't be undone.
